meta.purpose: CFB regression gate. Each fixture is an input the live CFB engine maps to a team. Any future change to src/data/cfb.js scoring (or the shared fingerprint engine in src/lib/scoring.js) must reproduce every winner here, or the diff must be reviewed and accepted.
meta.source: src/data/cfb.js via src/lib/scoring.js (fully wired), signatures = teamDims core + signature module answers; randoms = seeded uniform draws.
meta.synthetic_caveat: Signatures are constructed (each team's own core + its signature module answers). Randoms are seeded uniform-random answer draws.
meta.signature_method: coreProfile = teamDims[team]; module choices = the team's answer-key letter; sliders at the extreme on the team's side.
